title: Slow English Podcast #200: Rio de Janeiro

sentences.text: The city is called Rio de Janeiro.
Rio de Janeiro is in Brazil.
Brazil is the biggest country in South America.
Rio de Janeiro is not the capital of Brazil.
The capital is Brasilia, but Rio is one of the most famous cities in Brazil.
Rio is on the coast.
It is next to the Atlantic Ocean.
The city has many beaches, mountains, and forests.
About 6 million people live in Rio de Janeiro.
With the nearby towns, the area has more than 13 million people.
Rio de Janeiro is a very popular place for tourists.
Many people come to Rio every year.
They come to enjoy the beaches, music, food, and culture.
Let's talk about the most famous places in Rio.
One of the most famous landmarks is the Christ the Redeemer statue.
It is a big statue of Jesus Christ.
The statue is on top of a mountain called Corcovado.
The statue is 30 meters tall.
It is a symbol of peace.
Many people visit the statue and take pictures.
From the top of the mountain, you can see all of Rio.
It is a beautiful view.
Another famous place is Sugarloaf Mountain.
It is a big rock near the ocean.
You can go to the top by a cable car.
From there, you can see the beaches, the sea, and the city.
It is very popular at sunset.
Rio is also famous for its beaches.
Two of the most popular beaches are Copacabana and Ipanema.
People go to the beach to swim, relax, and play.
You can see people playing football, volleyball, or just walking.
The beaches are full of life.
One of the most famous events in Rio is Carnival.
Carnival is a big festival.
It happens every year in February or March.
It is before Lent in the Christian calendar.
During Carnival, people wear colorful costumes and dance in the streets.
There are big parades with music, dancing, and fun.
Many Samba schools take part in the parade.
Samba is the traditional dance and music in Brazil.
People practice all year for Carnival.
Many tourists come to Rio just to see Carnival.
It is one of the biggest festivals in the world.
Let's talk about food in Rio de Janeiro.
The food is delicious and full of flavor.
One traditional dish is called feijoada.
It is made with black beans and meat.
It is usually eaten with rice and orange slices.
People eat feijoada on Wednesdays or Saturdays.
People also eat a lot of grilled meat, rice, fish, and tropical fruits.
Mango, papaya, pineapple, and banana are very popular.
On the beach, you can drink coconut water and eat snacks like pão de queijo, cheese bread, or açaí in a bowl.
Now let's talk about nature.
Rio is a city with many green places.
There is a big forest in the city called Tijuca National Park.
It is one of the hiking or take photos in the forest.
You can see birds, monkeys, and waterfalls.
The weather in Rio is usually warm.
It is a tropical city.
In summer, it is hot and sometimes rainy.
In winter, it is still warm.
Many people visit Rio in winter because the weather is nice.
Rio is also a city of music.
Samba is very popular, but people also enjoy bossa nova funk and pop music.
In the streets and on the beach, you can often hear music.
People love to dance and celebrate.
People in Rio are called cariocas.
Cariocas are friendly and relaxed.
They enjoy life, music, the beach, and family.
They often greet you with a smile.
Let's review what we learned.
Rio de Janeiro is a city in Brazil.
It has beaches, mountains, music, and culture.
You can visit Christ the Redeemer, Sugarloaf Mountain, and the Carnival.
You can eat feijoada and tropical fruit.
You can dance samba and listen to music.
It is a fun, warm, and beautiful city.
I hope you can visit Rio de Janeiro one day.
It is a place full of life, color, and happiness.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Emili.
I hope you learned something new today.
